That interpretation is reinforced by the nearby analogs: several structurally related compounds with quinoline/quinazoline or higher aromatic burden differences, as well as higher polarity/acceptor burden, trend toward the non-mutagenic side when compared locally. Although a few scalar descriptors sometimes lean the other way in pairwise comparisons, the broader pattern is more consistent with reduced mutagenic liability.
